scope: Delta audit of NARA Record Group 615 and bulk exports, Black Vault releases, AARO reporting/media/information papers, FOIA process, material analysis, narrative infrastructure, and contactee-network records.
evidence_rule: An authentic record establishes the record, report, program, classification action, or administrative event. It does not automatically establish the extraordinary interpretation of its contents.

sources.title: Record Group 615 current agency inventory
sources.establishes: RG 615 currently lists FAA, NRC, ODNI, OSD, NSA, Department of State, and FBI series and is updated as agencies transfer records.
sources.does_not_establish: Completeness, online availability of every object, or truth of claims within transferred records.

sources.title: UAP bulk downloads
sources.establishes: NARA provides ZIP packages of digital objects and JSON metadata for listed collections.
sources.does_not_establish: That the bulk page is the newest complete agency inventory or that every catalog description has an online object.

sources.title: UAP Records Collection FAQ
sources.establishes: Federal agencies must review, identify, organize, and transfer UAP records under the statutory collection framework.
sources.does_not_establish: Immediate public release of classified or otherwise restricted material.

sources.title: Fiscal Year 2025 Consolidated Annual Report on UAP
sources.establishes: AARO received 319 reports, resolved 114 current and 256 earlier cases, referred nine for further analysis, and placed 191 in an active archive pending better data.
sources.does_not_establish: Exotic origin for active-archive or technically reviewed cases.

sources.title: FY2025 Virginia maritime-domain report
sources.establishes: A Navy report described approximately 100 airborne observations and two likely uncrewed surface systems and remained under investigation at the report cutoff.
sources.does_not_establish: A transmedium swarm, submerged base, one coordinated actor, or extraterrestrial origin.

sources.title: FY2025 nuclear-infrastructure UAS reports
sources.establishes: AARO received 50 reports of UAS incidents near nuclear infrastructure, weapons, and launch sites; the report states none were reported as UAP.
sources.does_not_establish: That the incursions were harmless, fully attributed, or extraterrestrial.

sources.title: Black Vault UFO Files Search, Releases 1-5
sources.evidence: A as publication history; B varies by underlying record
sources.establishes: The search corpus indexes 375 records: 212 documents, 133 videos, and 30 images, using processed PDFs, OCR, metadata, and transcripts where available.
sources.does_not_establish: OCR accuracy, completeness of older Black Vault holdings, or common origin of indexed reports.

sources.title: UAP Space Tiger Team record
sources.publisher: Department of War record released through FOIA; indexed by The Black Vault
sources.establishes: A 2023 coordination effort addressed spaceborne and transmedium UAP detection and operational frameworks.
sources.does_not_establish: Successful detection of exotic craft or proof that any event crossed domains.

sources.title: Navy FOIA appeal concerning 78 UAP photographs
sources.publisher: Department of the Navy record indexed by The Black Vault
sources.establishes: The Navy identified responsive photographs and continued to withhold them as classified, with no segregable portion released.
sources.does_not_establish: The content, quality, anomaly, or origin depicted in the photographs.

sources.title: NASA extraterrestrial-life communications planning
sources.publisher: NASA records released through FOIA; indexed by The Black Vault
sources.establishes: NASA personnel discussed communications planning for a definitive discovery of extraterrestrial life in June 2025.
sources.does_not_establish: That a discovery occurred or that a final approved protocol exists.

sources.title: Immaculate Constellation FOIA search appeal
sources.publisher: Department of War records and Black Vault appeal reporting
sources.establishes: A January 26, 2026 refusal declined to search because the alleged subject was said not to exist; a May 26, 2026 appeal was granted and a records search was ordered.
sources.does_not_establish: Existence of the alleged program.

sources.title: Reconstructed archive of deleted or unavailable correspondence
sources.establishes: Correspondent archives and related custodians can preserve portions of communications missing from one account.
sources.does_not_establish: Completeness or validation of every later claim.

sources.title: Project Moon Dust recovery records
sources.publisher: Department of State, CIA, DIA, and related records indexed by The Black Vault
sources.establishes: Historical programs and procedures existed to recover and analyze reentered foreign or unidentified space debris.
sources.does_not_establish: Alien crash retrieval.

sources.title: FAA PWA192 Nevada encounter records
sources.publisher: Federal Aviation Administration records indexed by The Black Vault
sources.establishes: FAA logs and ATC audio document a May 20, 2025 report of an aircraft-like object pacing a business jet; the released log reports no radar target and twelve ERAM radar files were withheld as Sensitive Security Information.
sources.does_not_establish: Exact kinematics, exotic origin, or absence from all sensor systems.

sources.title: Data Vetting and Accessibility for the Study of UAP
sources.establishes: Direct measurements, derived quantities, metadata, processing, range geometry, and data quality must be separated; multiple sensors can support triangulation and confuser rejection.
sources.does_not_establish: That a multi-sensor event is extraordinary or that processed imagery preserves native object properties.

sources.title: Event-Based Sensing for UAP Detection, Tracking, and Characterization
sources.publisher: Naval Postgraduate School / Sandia National Laboratories
sources.establishes: The WATCHER pipeline can detect, track, and characterize known drone signatures in event-based sensor data; the sensing architecture supports fast, low-bandwidth persistent monitoring.
sources.does_not_establish: Extraterrestrial detection or a finished universal UAP classifier.

sources.title: Capturing UAP Events: A Practical Photography Guide for Everyday Observers
sources.establishes: Recommended evidence practice includes immediate hashing, native unprocessed masters, high-bitrate video, UTC/location/equipment metadata, calibration, and separately labeled derivatives.
sources.does_not_establish: That an intact image proves an extraordinary object.

sources.title: AARO and the Declassification Process
sources.establishes: UAP-related imagery can be classified to protect the platform, location, metadata, source, method, or sensor capability even when the subject is ordinary; originating agencies control declassification.
sources.does_not_establish: That classification implies an extraordinary subject.

sources.title: 2025 UAP Workshop: Narrative Data, Infrastructures, and Analysis
sources.establishes: Workshop participants emphasized provenance, structured plus narrative reporting, optional metadata, human review, and explicit refusal-to-answer fields.
sources.does_not_establish: That standardization eliminates memory error, hoaxes, or interpretive disputes.

sources.title: UFO and UAP records by Record Group or collection
sources.establishes: NARA indexes UFO/UAP-related records across legacy FAA, NASA, CIA, OSD, Air Force, Navy, public-diplomacy, broadcasting, records-administration, and media collections in addition to RG 615.
sources.does_not_establish: One unified UAP program, a common attribution, or truth of every report preserved in those holdings.

sources.title: Known physically and optically fabricated UFO photographs in NARA scientific-study holdings
sources.establishes: NARA catalog records explicitly identify fabricated and optically fabricated UFO photographs created or assessed within a scientific-study context.
sources.does_not_establish: That adjacent images are fabricated or that a known-fake example resolves an unrelated case.

sources.title: AARO UAP report documents and imagery
sources.establishes: AARO labels secondary display captures, digitally altered copies presented as received, artistic reconstructions, and descriptive-only report text as distinct evidence objects.
sources.does_not_establish: The origin of the reported phenomena or equal evidentiary strength across all published media.

sources.title: KONA BLUE information release
sources.establishes: KONA BLUE was proposed as a prospective special access program but, according to AARO, was never approved, established, funded, or supplied with material.
sources.does_not_establish: An operational retrieval or exploitation program.

sources.title: ORNL analysis of an aluminum specimen
sources.establishes: The specimen as received was assessed as consistent with an ordinary aluminum alloy made for common applications.
sources.does_not_establish: That every alleged specimen is ordinary or that the accompanying recovery story was independently validated.

sources.title: 2025 UAP Workshop - Narrative Data, Infrastructures, and Analysis
sources.establishes: AARO sponsored an August 2025 workshop with 40 participants on narrative reports, infrastructure, and analysis.
sources.does_not_establish: That narrative reports are equivalent to calibrated sensor data or analytically worthless.

sources.title: Evaluation Proposal 585
sources.publisher: Department of War Office of Inspector General record indexed by The Black Vault
sources.establishes: The proposal states an objective to evaluate DoD intelligence and counterintelligence actions for detecting, collecting, exploiting, analyzing, and addressing UAP.
sources.does_not_establish: The content of classified benefits, protected capabilities, evaluation results, or extraterrestrial findings.

sources.title: FBI paranormal and contactee collection
sources.publisher: Federal Bureau of Investigation records indexed by The Black Vault
sources.establishes: Files document correspondence, monitoring, fraud concerns, organizations, investigators, and public controversies involving contactees and UFO movements.
sources.does_not_establish: FBI endorsement of the contact claims recorded in the files.

sources.title: NARA legacy UAP-related bulk collections
sources.establishes: The bulk surface includes Blue Book, Air Intelligence, 4602D, OSI, Condon, Roswell-source, Avrocar, audiovisual, photographic, and presidential-library collections.
sources.does_not_establish: One coherent secret program or the truth of each underlying report.

accepted_lore_concepts.summary: The Open Archive stores relationships among reports, incidents, sensor files, custody states, appeals, OCR derivatives, and later analyses rather than pretending one file is the truth.
Ashtar's open arrival becomes a constitutional and communications problem involving authentication, uncertainty, access, consent, and narrative capture.
Indexes, denial letters, classification actions, attachment lists, and transfer logs can be mission objects without inventing unseen content.
Missing correspondence is reconstructed through recipient copies, routing logs, calendars, attachment hashes, legal reviews, and Machine memory witnesses.
Historical foreign-materiel and space-debris recovery procedures inspire later anomalous-material teams without retroactively proving alien retrieval.
Every derived motion, size, or material claim remains linked to direct measurements, metadata, calibration, assumptions, transformations, uncertainty, and independent reproduction.
The first immutable hash defines the native master; every crop, enhancement, transcript, OCR layer, reconstruction, and briefing product is a separately authenticated fork.
Persistent event-based sensors create provisional tracks before identities; strategic advantage comes from maintaining custody and characterizing signatures rather than assigning faction immediately.
Classification and withholding are recorded separately for subject, platform, location, sensor capability, method, partner data, and witness identity.
No, unknown, not observed, not remembered, withheld, not applicable, and refuse to answer are distinct evidence states.

The Open Archive maps how one subject leaves different records in aviation, intelligence, military operations, science, public affairs, broadcasting, and records administration without flattening those institutional viewpoints into one file.

Fabricated, staged, optically altered, and misidentified examples are preserved as calibration controls. They test whether an analytical method can detect known error modes without prejudging unrelated unknowns.
Catalog, transfer, bulk export, mirror, and local-ingestion states are versioned separately; disagreement between surfaces is not automatically fraud.
Every visual record carries a class from native sensor product through documented export, secondary display capture, altered copy, artistic reconstruction, or narrative-only record.
Code names are tracked through allegation, suggestion, briefing, proposed compartment, approved program, funded operation, material receipt, and produced result.
An audit can reveal what is measured while protected methods, vulnerabilities, and results remain unknown; classification cannot stand in for the answer.
Original wording, interviewer effects, agency summaries, later retellings, and independent sensor evidence remain linked but distinct.
Program existence, phrase occurrence, official discussion, and responsive records are distinct propositions; an ordered search does not validate an allegation.
